rumpel.studio.subtitle.en: Turn a curious idea into a dancing fairytale.
rumpel.studio.subtitle.zh: 把一个灵感，变成会跳舞的奇幻短片。

rumpel.studio.promptPlaceholder.en: Describe the dance, setting, and mood…

rumpel.studio.defaultPrompt.en: A mischievous fictional Rumpelstiltskin dances on tiptoe in a candlelit castle, handmade 1980s fantasy-film aesthetic, expressive face, cinematic lighting, playful movement.
rumpel.studio.defaultPrompt.zh: 一个淘气的虚构侏儒怪在烛光城堡里踮脚跳舞，1980 年代手工奇幻电影美学，生动表情，电影灯光，俏皮的动作。

rumpel.studio.castlePrompt.en: A mischievous fictional Rumpelstiltskin dances on tiptoe in a candlelit castle, handmade 1980s fantasy-film aesthetic, expressive face, cinematic lighting, playful movement.
rumpel.studio.castlePrompt.zh: 一个淘气的虚构侏儒怪在烛光城堡里踮脚跳舞，1980 年代手工奇幻电影美学，生动表情，电影灯光，俏皮的动作。

rumpel.studio.forestPrompt.en: A fictional Rumpelstiltskin tiptoes and dances among mossy trees in a moonlit forest, tiny glowing fireflies, handmade vintage fantasy-film aesthetic, playful movement, cinematic lighting.
rumpel.studio.forestPrompt.zh: 虚构的侏儒怪在月光森林的青苔树木间踮脚跳舞，萤火虫闪烁，复古手工奇幻电影美学，俏皮动作，电影灯光。

rumpel.studio.ballroomPrompt.en: A fictional Rumpelstiltskin performs a mischievous tiptoe dance across a royal ballroom, velvet curtains and golden chandeliers, handmade vintage fantasy-film aesthetic, cinematic lighting.
rumpel.studio.ballroomPrompt.zh: 虚构的侏儒怪在皇家舞厅里俏皮地踮脚跳舞，天鹅绒帷幕与金色吊灯，复古手工奇幻电影美学，电影灯光。

rumpel.studio.setupDescription.en: Video generation needs a configured Fal API key. An administrator can connect the provider in Settings.
rumpel.studio.setupDescription.zh: 视频生成需要配置 Fal API 密钥。管理员可在设置中连接服务商。

rumpel.studio.emptyDescription.en: Choose a world, describe your dance, and make it move.
rumpel.studio.emptyDescription.zh: 选择世界，描述舞步，让想象动起来。

rumpel.studio.workingDescription.en: You can keep this page open while the provider finishes your clip.
rumpel.studio.workingDescription.zh: 请保持页面打开，等待服务商完成短片。

rumpel.studio.failedDescription.en: The provider could not finish this clip. Please try again.
rumpel.studio.failedDescription.zh: 服务商未能完成短片，请重试。

rumpel.studio.creditNotice.en: Credits are deducted when generation starts.

rumpel.studio.promptError.zh: 请用 1–1800 个字符描述场景。

rumpel.studio.refreshError.en: Unable to refresh this video. Try again.
rumpel.studio.refreshError.zh: 无法更新视频状态，请重试。

rumpel.studio.descriptionMeta.en: Create a fictional dancing Rumpelstiltskin video with AI.
rumpel.studio.descriptionMeta.zh: 用 AI 创作虚构侏儒怪跳舞短视频。
